text: Sign in with just your email to add routes, places, reports and votes. Group rides: start one, share a code or link, follow the leader and catch up on the map. Simpler ride recording: stop, save, drag two handles to share a stretch, export GPX. Record while navigating. Draw routes by tapping waypoints that snap to streets. Thumbs up/down on community routes. Upcoming BWG events and Donate in the menu. Grouped layers, welcome tour, new safety disclaimer, faster search.
